dialogues.speaker: Augustus Lovelace
dialogues.text: In Fontaine, a kind of transportation system called aquarails.

dialogues.speaker: Augustus Lovelace
dialogues.text: Aquabuses are dedicated vehicles that use them.

dialogues.speaker: Augustus Lovelace
dialogues.text: If you ever find yourself in Fontaine, you should definitely ride one.

dialogues.speaker: Augustus Lovelace
dialogues.text: Not only are they fast and convenient, but they even have Melusine guides on board who will provide commentary on the scenery.

dialogues.speaker: Augustus Lovelace
dialogues.text: I swear, I am not exaggerating in the least when I say that riding an aquabus is simply a sublime experience.
